confidence_notes: FX comes from an RBA search result showing 0.6720 USD per AUD on 2026-11-18. I ran only one price search for Trinidad. It returned mostly Cuba-wide, older or mixed-currency figures, such as Tripbase and Numbeo-derived pages. Meal, beer and coffee anchors are rough, based on about $5 for a budget meal, $15 for a mid-range meal, $2 for a beer and $1 to $2 for coffee. I found no reliable wine price, so wine is estimated from the beer relationship (about 1.5x beer). The cocktail is based on a roughly $4 Tripbase figure. I did not search accommodation. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates, assuming casas particulares dominate the market and registered hotels are scarce and pricey. Cuban pricing is distorted by the informal exchange rate and by dollarisation, which adds further uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Cuba-wide tourist pricing in casas particulares and paladares, with Caribbean and Latin American budget-tourism towns as a loose comparison.
